- **Commercial Laundry:** High-capacity tumble or stack units (such as [Dexter Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:2052456192516919178,headlineOfferDocid:6263707059761042457,productDocid:6263707059761042457&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiAkp_6y6iXAxX-iSsGHY6fKG0Qxa4PegoIAggACAAIGxAL) or Speed Queen ) serve high-volume laundry facilities and laundromats.[[1]](https://thelaundryboss.com/best-commercial-washers-and-dryers-for-laundromats-in-2025/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12664330008632291933&ibp=oshop)
